title: directly heated positive step function temperature co-efficient thermistors, Part 1: General requirements and methods of tests
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 1 ) is applicable to directly heated positive temperature coefficient thermistors, insulated or non-insulated, having a IS : 11534 ( Part 1 ) - 1985 resistance temperature characteristic which approximates to a step-function. Typically they are made of ferro-electric semi-conductive materials.
